comment: TARGETS are the staged goals. Enforcement in CI uses the regression floor from qa/coverage-baseline.json, so a PR that DROPS coverage below the snapshot fails, while already-covered modules are pushed toward the target over sprints.

app/services/piston_service.py.reason: Code-execution sandbox contract (wrapping, formatting, Piston API)

app/services/static_code_validator.py.reason: Execution security: blocks unsafe code before it reaches the sandbox

app/services/groq_service.py.reason: External AI provider contract, fallback chain, token metering

app/services/usage_service.py.reason: Per-user token caps / metering are the platform's cost control

app/services/auth_service.py.reason: Credentials, hashing, JWT issuance and verification

app/api/auth_deps.py.reason: Authentication dependency used by every protected route

exceptions.reason: Prompt-template assembly; exercised through integration paths
Base wrapper plumbing; per-language wrappers carry the assertions
